metric_semantics.comparison_set: Contemporaneous Parakeet control, Qwen3-ASR 1.7B MLX8bit and Granite TurboCTC FP16; same 24-case human corpus/order/repetition schedule and hardware; model/runtime configurations intentionally different and labeled.
metric_semantics.latency: Client-observed transcription endpoint duration; different engines, no end-to-end voice or quality-winner claim.
metric_semantics.percentiles: Native p50/p95 over 72 warm primary-human requests per arm; p99 not plotted. Repeated utterances are not 72 independent corpus items.
metric_semantics.provenance: Each point hashes the explicit sanitized native projection; projection-ledger.json maps that SHA to original private artifact SHA and structural/redaction changes.
metric_semantics.uncertainty: Paired per-case bootstrap from separately retained assessment; confidence interval tabulated, not plotted via unsupported schema.
metric_semantics.wer: Native summary.primary_human.micro_wer is total normalized edits / reference words; ratio, not sentence-average and not percentage. Synthetic cases excluded.

subtitle: Canonical primary-human warm C1: 24 distinct cases × 3 = 72 requests/arm. All arms have critical-case errors; no promotion. Qwen paired WER uncertainty overlaps zero.
